cases.title: Click on radio button label to select
cases.goal: Ensure that the label click functionality works as intended for selecting radio buttons.
cases.precondition: User is on the test page with radio buttons and their labels displayed.
cases.instructions: Verify that clicking on the label text of a radio button selects the associated radio button.
cases.expectedResult: The associated radio button becomes selected when its label is clicked.

cases.title: User clears textarea content
cases.goal: Ensure that the textarea can be cleared of all content by the user.
cases.precondition: User is on the test page with the Textarea section visible and the textarea contains text.
cases.instructions: This test case verifies that when a user selects all text in the textarea and deletes it, the textarea becomes empty as expected.
cases.expectedResult: The textarea becomes empty after all text is selected and deleted.

cases.title: Confirm Color Selection
cases.goal: Ensure the color picker field reflects the confirmed color selection.
cases.precondition: User has selected a new color in the color picker dialog.
cases.instructions: Verify that when a user confirms their color selection, the color picker field updates to show the selected color value.
cases.expectedResult: The color picker field updates to show the selected color value.

cases.title: User toggles checkbox by clicking on label
cases.goal: Ensure that clicking on the label toggles the checkbox state.
cases.precondition: User is on the test page with the Checkbox section visible and the checkbox is in either checked or unchecked state.
cases.instructions: This test case verifies that when the user clicks on the label associated with the checkbox, it toggles the state of the checkbox (checked to unchecked or vice versa).
cases.expectedResult: The state of the checkbox changes after clicking on its associated label.

cases.title: Select a New Color
cases.goal: Ensure the color picker updates to reflect the selected color.
cases.precondition: User has opened the color picker dialog.
cases.instructions: Verify that when a user selects a different color from the color picker dialog, the picker updates to display the newly selected color.
cases.expectedResult: The color picker displays the newly selected color.

cases.title: User checks the terms and conditions checkbox
cases.goal: Ensure the checkbox can be checked by the user.
cases.precondition: User is on the test page with the Checkbox section visible and the checkbox is initially unchecked.
cases.instructions: This test case verifies that when the user clicks on the checkbox labeled 'I agree to the terms and conditions', the checkbox changes its state from unchecked to checked.
cases.expectedResult: The checkbox becomes checked after the user clicks on it.

cases.title: User enters text in textarea
cases.goal: Ensure that text entered by the user is displayed in the textarea.
cases.precondition: User is on the test page with the Textarea section visible.
cases.instructions: This test case verifies that when a user clicks on the textarea labeled 'Enter some text' and types any text, the text is displayed within the textarea field as expected.
cases.expectedResult: The text entered by the user is displayed within the textarea field.

cases.title: Select a radio button option
cases.goal: Ensure that the selected radio button reflects the user's choice.
cases.precondition: User is on the test page with the Radio Buttons section visible containing three radio options.
cases.instructions: Verify that when a user clicks on one of the three radio buttons (Radio25, Radio27, Radio29), that specific radio button becomes selected.
cases.expectedResult: The clicked radio button is selected and visually indicated as such.
